content: Tauri 2 Channel API: use tauri::ipc::Channel<T> as a command parameter for streaming (pty output). Rust loops writing chunks via channel.send(). JS side receives via the channel object passed from invoke(). Channel is preferred over events for high-throughput ordered streams. Events (AppHandle::emit / listen() on JS) suit fire-and-forget lifecycle signals (node-created, node-exited). Both can coexist: Channel for per-pty byte stream, events for canvas state changes.
